FAQs

- [**What’s the difference between monthly and annual billing?**](https://companycam.com/pricing#question-1)




Annual is discounted and billed once per year. Monthly bills month-to-month for more flexibility. You can switch at renewal, and we’ll remind you before your annual plan renews.

- [**Do annual subscriptions auto-renew?**](https://companycam.com/pricing#question-2)




Yes. Annual plans auto-renew at the end of the term. We’ll email you ahead of time so there are no surprises.

- [**Can I switch plans or change my billing?**](https://companycam.com/pricing#question-3)




Yes. You can upgrade, downgrade, or switch between monthly and annual anytime. At the end of your annual term, you can switch to monthly before your plan renews. If you cancel mid-year, you’ll keep access through the end of your annual term.

- [**Which plan includes AI features?**](https://companycam.com/pricing#question-4)




AI features are included in Crew, Scale, and Enterprise. If you’re on another plan and want AI, you can upgrade at any time.

- [**Can I cancel anytime?**](https://companycam.com/pricing#question-5)




Yes. You can cancel whenever you want. You’ll keep access through the end of your billing period.

- [**What counts as a ​“user” or ​“seat,” and can I add or remove them?**](https://companycam.com/pricing#question-6)




A seat is one person with their own login. Anyone who needs to capture photos, manage projects, or access job documentation gets a seat. You can add seats anytime as you grow, and if someone leaves, just remove their seat. Your photos and project history stay in your account.

- [**Can subcontractors use CompanyCam?**](https://companycam.com/pricing#question-7)




Yes. You can invite subcontractors when you need them and control what they can access.

- [**How long do you store my photos, and are they secure?**](https://companycam.com/pricing#question-8)




As long as you’re a CompanyCam customer, your photos stay in your account. They’re stored securely in the cloud and encrypted in transit. Only people you invite can access them. If you ever cancel, you can export your photos before your access ends.

- [**Does CompanyCam use a lot of storage on my phone?**](https://companycam.com/pricing#question-9)




No. Your job photos are stored in the cloud, so they don’t clog your camera roll. (You may see temporary storage used for uploads, but it won’t grow indefinitely.)

- [**Is CompanyCam offline-ready?**](https://companycam.com/pricing#question-10)




Yes. You can capture photos on-site without service, and everything syncs when you’re back online.

- [**Is CompanyCam available on iOS and Android?**](https://companycam.com/pricing#question-11)




Yes. CompanyCam works on both iOS and Android.

- [**Do Dual Video and LiDAR work on all devices?**](https://companycam.com/pricing#question-12)




Dual Video and LiDAR capture require supported iOS devices. Once captured, the videos and photos can be viewed and used by anyone on your team on any device. To capture LiDAR photos, you’ll need at least one supported iPhone or iPad with a LiDAR sensor.



Supported devices include:



  - iPhone 12 Pro and later

  - iPhone 12 Pro Max and later

  - iPad Pro 13-inch (M4) and 11-inch (M4)

  - iPad Pro 12.9‑inch (4th generation) and later

  - iPad Pro 11-inch (2nd generation) and later
